name: Vigevano (Italy)
description: White field with a red border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Vigevano (a castle beneath an eagle on red) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Vigevano, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 9 January 2001.

features.role: Vigevano arms — castle beneath an eagle on red, crowned, within branches
